method: Read each of the 50 questions, its type, reference claims, answer, and annotation notes independently of the dataset generator.
Read the complete canonical text of every selected gold chunk and checked semantic support for the reference claims.
Checked every gold paper ID, chunk ID, and page range against the 5,858-chunk canonical processed store.
For every unanswerable question, ran literal case-insensitive anchor conjunctions over every corpus chunk and inspected unrelated near matches before confirming refusal.
limitations: This is an AI-assisted independent manual semantic review, not a claim of human review. Absence findings are bound to the frozen local corpus fingerprint and the recorded literal conjunction searches.
